one-piece.notes: Kitsu episodeCount is null (ongoing; Kitsu has placeholder episode records up to 1410). AnimeFillerList lists aired episodes through 1168. Elbaph is ongoing (to=null). One Piece Wiki gives Romance Dawn 1-4 and Orange Town 4-8 (ep 4 shared); split here as 1-3 / 4-8. Loguetown per wiki is 45 and 48-53 (46-47 adapt the Buggy's Crew cover story) - kept as one range 45-53. Episodes 68-69 (Koby-Meppo cover story), 336, 406-407 and 907 are left as gaps. Enies Lobby (279-283 recaps; 291-292, 303 filler), Post-Enies Lobby (317-319 filler), Post-War (492, 498-499), Fish-Man Island (542), Punk Hazard (590) contain standalone filler but are kept as single ranges. Arcs interrupted by filler (Impel Down, Wano Country) are split into multiple entries with the same name; Wano is 890-894, 897-906, 908-1028 and 1031-1085, with 907 a filler gap. Straw Hat's Separation Serial (453-456) is not a story arc on the wiki: these episodes adapt a manga cover-page serial (the wiki lists it under Cover Stories), and Wikipedia counts them in season 13 (Impel Down). It is kept as its own entry so the episodes are labelled. Wikipedia's seasons (DVD seasons) do not always start where arcs do: season 4 (Alabasta) starts at 93, not 92; season 20 (Wano) starts at 892, because season 19 runs 783-891 and takes in Levely plus 890-891; season 21 (Egghead) starts at 1089, while the wiki ends Wano at 1085 and starts Egghead at 1086. Arc ranges here follow the wiki. Wikipedia season 22 (Elbaph) starts at 1156, matching the wiki.

boruto-naruto-next-generations.notes: Wikipedia's Boruto episode list has no arc or season breakdown, so ranges come from Narutopedia only, checked against AnimeFillerList's canon ranges (Sarada 19-24, Momoshiki 51-66, Steam Ninja Scrolls 106-111, Kawaki 188-220, Sasuke Retsuden/Code 282-293 agree). AnimeFillerList's Ao canon range is 181-189 vs Narutopedia's Ao 178-187 / Kawaki 188-220. Names vary between fan sources: the Kawaki arc is often called the 'Vessel' arc. filler=true only where AnimeFillerList labels the episodes filler (Genin Mission 40-41, Chocho, Konohamaru's Love); most other non-manga arcs (Academy Entrance, School Trip, Mitsuki's Disappearance, Time Slip, Kara Actuation, Chunin Re-Examination, Great Sea Battle, Kawaki & Himawari Academy, Labyrinth Game) are anime-original but labelled 'anime canon' by AnimeFillerList, so filler=false. Gaps are standalone episodes.

fairy-tail.notes: Arc ranges from the Fairy Tail Wiki (episode lists per arc) cross-checked with AnimeFillerList. Wikipedia's Fairy Tail list has no arc breakdown. The wiki and AnimeFillerList use continuous numbering 1-328; Kitsu splits it into fairy-tail (1-175), fairy-tail-2014 (176-277, numbered 1-102) and fairy-tail-2018 (278-328, numbered 1-51). Ranges here are converted to each Kitsu entry's own numbering. Common alternate names: Eisenwald = Lullaby arc, Sub-Zero Emperor Lyon = Galuna Island arc. Daphne per wiki is 69-75; AnimeFillerList has 69 as mixed and 70-75 filler. Grand Magic Games continues into fairy-tail-2014 episodes 1-28. Standalone fillers 9, 19, 50 are inside the ranges as the wiki lists them.

fairy-tail-2014.notes: Arc ranges from the Fairy Tail Wiki (episode lists per arc) cross-checked with AnimeFillerList. Wikipedia's Fairy Tail list has no arc breakdown. The wiki and AnimeFillerList use continuous numbering 1-328; Kitsu splits it into fairy-tail (1-175), fairy-tail-2014 (176-277, numbered 1-102) and fairy-tail-2018 (278-328, numbered 1-51). Ranges here are converted to each Kitsu entry's own numbering. Kitsu ep 1 = overall ep 176. Disagreement: the wiki ends Grand Magic Games at overall 203 (Kitsu 28) and starts Eclipse Celestial Spirits at 204 (Kitsu 29); AnimeFillerList marks filler from overall 202 (Kitsu 27), with 201 mixed. The Avatar arc starts at overall 276 (Kitsu 101) and continues in fairy-tail-2018. Overall ep 268 (Kitsu 93) inside Fairy Tail Zero is filler.

dragon-ball.notes: Saga names and ranges from Wikipedia's season/saga table. dragon-ball-z.notes: Saga ranges from the Dragon Ball Wiki (Funimation saga names). Wikipedia's 9 seasons agree with every season boundary (74/75, 107/108, 139/140, 165/166, 194/195, 219/220, 253/254) but do not split sagas within a season, so the in-season splits (Raditz/Vegeta 6/7, Namek/Ginyu 67/68, Garlic Jr./Trunks 117/118, Trunks/Androids 125/126, Imperfect/Perfect Cell 152/153, Other World/Great Saiyaman 199/200, Great Saiyaman/World Tournament 209/210, Babidi/Majin Buu 231/232, Fusion/Kid Buu 275/276, Kid Buu/Peaceful World 287/288) rest on the wiki alone. dragon-ball-super.notes: Wikipedia lists 5 sagas: God of Destruction Beerus 1-18, Golden Frieza 19-27, Universe 6 28-46, Goku Black/Zamasu 47-76, Universe Survival 77-131. The Dragon Ball Wiki splits out two anime-only sagas, Copy-Vegeta (42-46) and Paradise Plant (68-76), which are included here as filler (AnimeFillerList: 42-46 filler; 68-70 and 73-76 filler, 71-72 anime canon). Disagreement: the wiki puts the Beerus/Golden Frieza boundary at 15/16; Wikipedia's 18/19 is used.

hunter-x-hunter-2011.notes: No filler. Disagreement: Hunter x Hunter Wiki gives Heavens Arena 27-36 and Yorknew City 37-58; Wikipedia gives Heavens Arena 27-38 and 'Phantom Troupe' 39-58. Wikipedia boundary used, with the fan-standard name 'Yorknew City'. Both sources include the Zoldyck Family episodes (22-26) in the Hunter Exam arc. Wikipedia calls the last arc 'Election'.

black-clover-tv.notes: Slug 'black-clover' on Kitsu is the 2016 Jump Festa special (id 12625); the TV series is 'black-clover-tv'. Season 2 (2026, Kitsu id 50024, slug Black-Clover-Season-2) is a separate entry and not covered. Wikipedia has no arc breakdown; ranges from the Black Clover Wiki, matched by secondary arc guides. The wiki lists ep 51 in both Seabed Temple and Witches' Forest, and ep 96 in both Royal Knights and Elf Reincarnation; assigned to the earlier arc here. Spade Kingdom Raid continues past ep 170 (wiki 168-174 in continuous numbering). Elf Reincarnation (97-157) contains filler 123-125, 131, 134-135, 142-149 per AnimeFillerList, not split out because no source names those as arcs.

d-gray-man.notes: Wikipedia has no arc breakdown; ranges from the D.Gray-man Wiki. yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters.notes: Ranges from Yugipedia arc pages; Wikipedia's 5 seasons agree at 49/50, 97/98, 144/145, 184/185. Yugipedia groups 41-49 as 'Domino City Battles' (Legendary Heroes 43-45 and Dungeon Dice Monsters 47-49 sub-stories); Wikipedia season 1 names them Legendary Heroes and Dungeon Dice Monsters. Battle City is split as Yugipedia does (part 1: 50-97, part 2: 122-144); Wikipedia calls part 2 'Enter the Shadow Realm' (dub). Pharaoh's Memories (199-219) is the dub's 'Dawn of the Duel'; the final arc is Yugipedia's 'Battle Ritual', also called 'Ceremonial Battle', which Wikipedia folds into season 5. AnimeFillerList's Yu-Gi-Oh page is the 1998 series, not Duel Monsters, so filler flags follow Yugipedia/Wikipedia's anime-original arcs (Domino City Battles, Virtual World, Waking the Dragons, Grand Championship).
